annotations.title: What changed in a record, and when

description: The dated changes in one official record, newest first, edition by edition as the agency published them: for a nursing home (by CCN) its ratings, staffing, citations, penalties and owner organisations; aircraft (N-number) and trials (NCT id) as their history loads. Each change shows the field, before and after, the edition date and the exact source file. Optional since and until dates. Changes about private persons are counted, not shown.

ccn.description: Nursing home CMS Certification Number (6 characters).

since.description: Only changes in editions on or after this date (YYYY-MM-DD).

until.description: Only changes in editions on or before this date (YYYY-MM-DD).
